title: Profile & account settings
subtitle: Account details
loadFailed: The profile could not be loaded.
avatarNote: Your profile picture is generated from the initials of your name.

security.title: Account security
security.body: Signed-in devices, signing out of any of them, and two-factor sign-in are managed in <link>Account security</link>. Changing your password inside the panel has not been built yet; to change it, use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.zoneDesc: All sites stop being monitored, sessions are revoked and the account's personal data is permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

items.sites: Immediately stops monitoring all your sites and invalidates each one's pairing credentials; the plugin on the site will no longer connect to this panel.
items.sessions: Signs out every session on the account (any device) at once.
items.personal: Removes your email, name, phone number and notification tokens from the account. Your email address is released, and you can sign up again with it later.
items.audit: Keeps the event history, without personal data, for audit.

delete.confirm: To confirm, type “{phrase}” and enter your current password:
delete.failed: Account deletion failed. Please try again.
